title: The Silver Thread
working_title: History Before Time: The Silver Thread
logline: A young Afrikaner soldier, hollowed out by the Border War, is taken in by the San trackers he served beside and then watched his country discard — and over years in the bush is unmade, by people who own almost nothing, into the calmest man in any room.
blueprint: character origin — grounded, not woo (the human prequel to the Jakobus arc)
market: literary historical — the quiet, true sibling of the series joyride
